Container.Name: Sleutharr
Container.Overview:
Sleutharr answers one question: "I requested this - where did it die?"
It stitches a single request into one timeline across Seerr/Overseerr/Jellyseerr, Sonarr/Radarr, your download client and Plex, then tells you where the chain broke and what to do about it.
Read-only: Sleutharr never writes to any *arr app, download client or Plex.
All service URLs and API keys are configured in the web UI, not through environment variables. Add your services on the Settings page after first start.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Sleutharr web interface.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Holds the SQLite database, the generated secret key, and logs.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns files written to /config.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns files written to /config.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone, e.g. Europe/London. Affects displayed timestamps.

Config.Name: CSRF trusted origins
Config.Description: Only needed behind an https reverse proxy. Comma-separated, e.g. https://sleutharr.example.com
